dr5_remeasure.conclusion: Not a hosted cold start. The first initialize answered in 1.049 s and all three were within 0.1 s. 'pending' with 0 mcp__ tools at init is the normal state for an HTTP server in this client - all four trials showed it, including the three that worked - because the tools are deferred and reached through the client's own ToolSearch. The failure is that a run sometimes never issues that ToolSearch.
dr5_remeasure.workaround: Run `claude mcp list` once between `claude mcp add` and the first prompt. It forces the health check and the following run used the tool (1 of 1). One trial, not proof, but it costs ~2 s and cannot hurt.

defects_closed.evidence: bundle a3 created INV-2026-0001 with no business profile and returned 'No business profile yet: the PDF shows a placeholder issuer. Run business_set {name, address, vat_id, iban} and render the PDF again.'; remote b3 did the same over HTTP.
expense_to_invoice emitted {unit_price: 50, tax_rate: 23}, total_net 'EUR 50.00', vat_unknown_lines 0, vat_note 'Every line carries the VAT rate recorded on its expense.'
expense_to_invoice returned marked_rebilled: false; the flag was set only by the later expense_mark_rebilled, and the store now records rebilled_invoice 'INV-2026-0001'.
hosted invoice_pdf says 'Download (HTML invoice, print to PDF, valid 1 hour)' and the model repeated it; local invoice_pdf says 'Wrote PDF invoice <path>' and the file starts %PDF-1.3.
business_set {name, tax_rate: 23} -> default_tax_rate 23 with the echo line 'Read tax_rate: 23 as default_tax_rate: 23.'; the following invoice_create returned EUR 338.25.

defects_open.title: 1 of 3 fresh first runs answers with zero tool calls
defects_open.repro: rm -rf /tmp/x && mkdir /tmp/x && cd /tmp/x && claude mcp add --transport http --scope local tt https://mcp.zovo.one/mcp/time-tracker --header "Authorization: Bearer <key>" && claude -p "Start a timer for Remote Co" --model sonnet --output-format stream-json --verbose --allowedTools "$(cat allow_tt.txt)". Trial 1 of 3: 0 tool calls in 8.9 s. Transcript /private/tmp/uv7/t1/run.jsonl.
defects_open.workaround: `claude mcp list` between add and the first prompt.
defects_open.fix_direction: Not fixable on the hosted side: initialize is 1.05 s and correct. Either the client should not report 'pending' for a server it has not tried, or the server list should resolve before the first turn.

defects_open.title: price_check is skipped entirely; WebFetch answers the URL question alone (D-4 reopened and worse)
defects_open.repro: claude -p "What does this cost right now: https://books.toscrape.com/catalogue/a-light-in-the-attic_1000/index.html" --mcp-config /private/tmp/uv2/mcp.json --strict-mcp-config --model sonnet --allowedTools "$(cat /private/tmp/uv2/allow_r3.txt),WebFetch" -> /private/tmp/uv2/out/r4_pt1b.jsonl, CALLS(1): WebFetch. Answer GBP 51.77 from the HTML; no history point stored, no confidence flag, no watch.
defects_open.fix_direction: price_check's description must claim the URL case explicitly ('use this instead of fetching the page: it stores the point for history and alerts'). On capability alone a generic fetcher wins.

defects_open.title: download serves text/html under a .pdf filename, and the note still says 'the PDF'
defects_open.repro: curl -sI https://mcp.zovo.one/mcp/download/939925972c580b255e5a1f5c24724adf -> HTTP 200, content-type text/html; charset=utf-8, content-disposition: inline; filename="INV-2026-0001.pdf". The same tool response ends 'No business profile yet: the PDF shows a placeholder issuer.'
defects_open.fix_direction: Set the disposition filename to .html on the HTML path and reuse documentLabel() in the business-profile note.

defects_open.title: with round 3's exact allowlist, WebFetch is denied and pt1 ends asking for permission instead of falling back to price_check
defects_open.repro: the first pt1 run, allowlist = /private/tmp/uv2/allow_r3.txt (MCP tools only): CALLS(2) ToolSearch, WebFetch; final text 'you'll need to approve the WebFetch tool ... In round 3 the same allowlist let WebFetch through, so the client's permission behaviour changed; the scored pt1 is the re-run with WebFetch appended.
defects_open.fix_direction: Record only. Relevant to reading the r3/r4 pt1 delta as a code change - it is not.
